description: Rank skills against a free-form task description. Use when the skill you need is not in the catalogue the host delivered, so asking by name is impossible and asking by task is not. Each row carries the skill's own description — its routing criteria, including any clause saying when to use something else. CHOOSE BY READING THE ROWS, then open at most two bodies with read_skill. Returns names, scores, personas and descriptions — never bodies.

task.description: The task to match skills against.

name: suggest_skill_for_task
